messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating rollout -> environment: prod-us-west :rocket:
deploy-bot: release_id=rel-2026-03-12, window=02:00-03:00 UTC, change_window=standard, strategy=gradual-canary
deploy-bot: commits:
```
sha: 9f8c7a1  author: @ben  link: https://git/repo/commit/9f8c7a1  msg: svc/router: fix header race
sha: a1b2c3d  author: @liu  link: https://git/repo/commit/a1b2c3d  msg: runtime: improve batching heuristics
sha: ffeedd0  author: @alicia  link: https://git/repo/commit/ffeedd0  msg: docs: release notes + upgrade steps
```
Alicia (releases): Can we pin the canary to 9f8c7a1 for now? want a quick revert if things go sideways :thinking_face:
Ben: Canary passed smoke locally and in staging yesterday. router change has a small risk for 503s on burst. monitoring alert rule already added.
Sam (oncall): Heads up — after the first canary batch the router pod in us-west-2 showed increased 5xx for ~45s. I rolled that canary back manually and opened incident #INC-3412.
Alicia (releases): Good catch. What was the failing sha?
Sam (oncall): It was 9f8c7a1. Reverted to previous sha bbcc334 and retries cleared the spike.
deploy-bot: Updated rollout plan:
- canary batch -> blocked for sha 9f8c7a1 (pin to bbcc334)
- ops_action: rollback-on-5xx (automatic)
- notify: eng-oncall, infra, devex
CI Bot: PRs referenced:
- PR #482 by @ben -> https://git/repo/pull/482
- PR #489 by @liu -> https://git/repo/pull/489
Liu (devex): a1b2c3d is safe to re-run separately — it's runtime-only and can be deployed to a subset of hosts. suggest we decouple and ship after router fix.
Alicia (releases): Agree. Plan: pin prod to bbcc334, create follow-up release for runtime only once router fix is validated. Update release notes to call out rollback and monitoring thresholds.
Ben: I'll open a hotfix PR for router fix with additional unit and integration tests, link will go into this thread once ready.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed for batch-1 -> rolled to sha bbcc334 :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout status: paused (awaiting new canary sha).
Alicia (releases): tagging owners for postmortem and release notes: @ben @liu @sam
Ben: PR #495 opened with fix, author @ben -> https://git/repo/pull/495  includes test coverage and a short load test report.
Alicia (releases): once CI green and load test in review we will re-run canary with 9f8c7a1+fix (new sha will be referenced). keep deploy window open for 30m buffer.
deploy-bot: Final note: audit log updated with commit authors and PR links. Release artifact: s3://releases/rel-2026-03-12/ (checksums included)
CI Bot: CI pipeline passed for PR #495 -> status: green :large_green_circle:
Alicia (releases): OK re-run canary in 10m. please call out any regressions immediately.
Sam (oncall): I will watch alerts and can escalate to emergency rollback if needed. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Re-run canary started with sha d4e5f6a (merge of PR #495) -> monitoring enabled, automatic rollback on 5xx.
deploy-bot: Canary completed successfully, no elevated 5xx for 15m. Proceeding with staggered rollout to remaining hosts. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> all hosts in prod-us-west now at sha d4e5f6a. Duration: 52m.
Alicia (releases): Thanks everyone — updating release notes and closing incident #INC-3412. Great coordination. :tada:
